home.title: What would you like to learn?
home.lead: Choose a teacher and a lesson. Sign in when you want to chat or keep your progress.
landing.subtitle: Pick a teacher and start talking. Free lessons need no account and no wallet.
landing.step1: Choose Teacher Ray or Teacher Pi
landing.step2: Open a lesson now. Every lesson is free during this demo.
landing.hero: Talk with a teacher who has a character, then practice for real.
landing.freeNote: Free for 10 prompts per account, then wait 24 hours.
pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lead: This demo does not charge for lessons.
pricing.free1: Chat with Teacher Ray and Teacher Pi
pricing.free2: 10 prompts per account, then a 24-hour reload
pricing.free3: Lessons are open for free during the demo
pricing.pro3: Checkout is not open, so nothing is charged
pricing.closed: Checkout is not open yet. The free plan works now.
quota.blocked: You have used this window. Prompts return
notFound.title: This page is not here
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the address is incomplete.
landing.step3: Chat, ask for a hint, see an example, then practice
landing.step4: Your lesson is saved so you can continue later
landing.demoNote: MVP for Solana Colosseum · devnet payments only
teacher.disabledBody: This teacher is not open for lessons in the MVP.
onboarding.title: Set up your learning profile
onboarding.body: Choose what feels right for now. You can skip and change this later in your profile.
chat.previewBanner: Open the room now. Register before your first message.
chat.gateBody: You can look around and draft a message. Sending the first one asks you to register, then brings you back to this lesson.
chat.thinking: Your teacher is preparing a response…
chat.error: Message not sent. Please try again.
chat.offline: You are offline. Your draft is saved.
chat.aiNotice: You are chatting with AI. Answers may contain mistakes.
chat.goals: What you did in this lesson
progress.empty: Start your first lesson to see your progress here.
lesson.complete: Lesson complete. See what you learned.
guest.banner: This progress stays on this device. Create an account to continue on another device.
auth.name: Name for your teacher to use
auth.switchLogin: Already have an account. Sign in
auth.needAccount: This lesson needs an account before you can pay and unlock it.
auth.invalid: That name or password is not correct
auth.nameTaken: That name is taken. Try signing in
auth.nameInvalid: Use a name up to 40 characters
auth.returnNote: After you sign in or register, you'll return to the page you chose.
pay.pending: Checking payment. Please do not pay again yet.
pay.cancelled: Payment cancelled. The lesson has not been unlocked.
pay.failed: Could not verify payment. Check your history before retrying.
pay.title: Unlock lesson
pay.fee: The network fee is separate from the lesson price. Your wallet pays it in devnet SOL, usually under 0.00001 SOL.
pay.insufficient: Not enough devnet SOL. Use the faucet, then check this same purchase again. Do not start a second payment while one is still pending.
pay.syncing: The transaction is waiting for access to be granted. We will check again. Do not pay twice.
pay.noWallet: No wallet in this browser. Use Phantom or Solflare and switch the network to devnet.
pay.connectHint: Connect a wallet only when you are ready to buy a lesson.
pay.cancelledHint: This purchase did not grant access.
pay.failedHint: This transaction did not match the purchase, so nothing was unlocked.
profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name for your teacher to use
profile.guest: You are browsing as a viewer. Create an account to keep progress with you.
profile.deleteBody: This removes chats and progress for this account. The account, payments, and lessons you already unlocked stay.
profile.historyNote: You can try a free lesson without connecting a wallet.
profile.tutorLesson: Teacher replies come from that teacher's lesson and style on the server.
profile.tutorModel: Open replies use GPT-6 Luna Pro through OpenRouter. Practice scores are still checked on the server.
chats.title: Chats
chats.empty: No chats yet. Choose a teacher and open a lesson.
chats.guestBody: Open a chat room now. Register before your first message.
progress.guestBody: Open a lesson now. Progress is saved after you register and send your first message.

notFound.body: Go back to the teachers on the home page
